nonfunctional_targets.target: Local boot `make dev` with mock providers and a usable test login within 2 minutes on documented dev hardware (excluding first install)
API read p95 < 500 ms for indexed list/detail operations at 50k rows in staging, excluding external calls
UI usable at 375px and desktop 1280px, WCAG 2.2 AA target for key flows, keyboard/screen reader labels
No production write without explicit owner approval and exact destination
At most one unresolved submission attempt per (export hash, account, platform)
No approved export mutates in place; prior versions retained per policy
Backups: PostgreSQL PITR where supported; documented RPO <=24h, RTO <=4h during business hours after restore drills (initial targets, not promises)
Job recovery after process termination; no unbounded external retry or write
Per-provider daily/monthly cost caps and reservations; unknown pricing blocks optional paid step
95% of background-job state transitions reflected in UI within 10s under normal operation
No sensitive provider tokens, raw logs, or source credentials exposed in UI or downloadable job artifacts

release_blockers: Owner Google OAuth client and consent not configured
Hosted authenticated golden workflow not verified
Real AI/vidIQ/YouTube/Meta backend grants and complete adapters missing
Full API schema conformance, media QA corpus, workload/load targets and full release suite incomplete
